decision_conditions: The proposed development would result in an over intensification of the site which would create unreasonable levels of disturbances, including noise to the detriment of neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The applicant has failed to provide an acceptable Parking Stress Survey (Lambeth Methodology) to demonstrate that the proposed development, which provides no additional off-street parking, would not result in an unacceptable increase in on-street parking demand. There is a requirement for on-site parking provision or robust evidence to justify a car-free approach. In the absence of such evidence, the proposal is considered to hinder the free flow of traffic and compromise highway safety, contrary to Sutton Local Plan Policies 36 and 37.
